name: s3GeneratePresignedURL
syntax: s3GeneratePresignedURL(bucket, object [, expireDate, httpMethod, accessKeyId, secretKey, host])
description: Generates a presigned URL that grants temporary, signed access to an object in an S3 (or S3-compatible) bucket. The expireDate argument accepts a datetime (the URL is valid until that instant) or a plain number of minutes; it defaults to 15 minutes.

params.name: bucket
params.description: The name of the S3 bucket containing the object.

params.name: object
params.description: The object key the URL will grant access to.

params.name: expireDate
params.description: Expiry: a datetime (URL valid until that instant) or a number of minutes. Defaults to 15 minutes.

params.name: httpMethod
params.description: HTTP method the presigned URL is valid for. Defaults to GET.

params.name: accessKeyId
params.description: Inline AWS access key id. Overrides credentials from Application.cfc and environment variables.

params.name: host
params.description: Inline endpoint URL for S3-compatible providers (e.g. Cloudflare R2, MinIO).

examples.title: Generate a presigned GET URL
examples.description: Creates a URL that expires in 60 minutes.

examples.title: Generate a presigned PUT URL
examples.description: The fourth argument selects the HTTP method.
